**THE BLOG IS THE FLOOR; THIS IS THE PRODUCT.** A publishing app is a commodity — WordPress is free. **What is not free is a publication that keeps producing.** Most people stop in six weeks because nothing is arriving to write about. **So we give them the app and charge for the thing they will actually be stuck on.**

**FOUR THINGS, ALL ON EXISTING MACHINERY:**
**1. A CORPUS** — their posts, docs, sources, ingested and retrievable. **BB Docs + Vectorize + the WHIM corpus pattern. Nothing new.**
**2. A RAG AGENT ON IT** — drafts from THEIR material, cited. **The difference between an AI writing tool and a ghostwriter who has read your archive.**
**3. BURN THEIR FEED** — what they follow becomes what they write about. **Their reading list is their editorial calendar**, and burn is already the metered mechanism (m65735).
**4. CUSTOM AGENT + DELIVERY** — named agent, their voice, Telegram or wherever they actually read. Connectors declared per frag (m65708).

**WHY OURS IS NOT JUST ANOTHER AI WRITER: the agent has a handle, a wallet and a subject** (BEB-5793, landed). **It publishes as ITSELF**, is metered per call, and gets exactly the capabilities the owner grants — draft-only, or draft-and-publish. **And because the publication is MCP-native, the writer is a caller of the same tools a person uses. One surface, two kinds of author.**

**PRICING IS THE SAME RAILS — invent none:** corpus storage Class 1 measured · agent calls Class 1 through the gateway · the agent itself Class 2 standing · delivery metered per send. **One bill for the publication and the writer.**
